name: free-to-review
description: Code reviews and requests answered by free LLMs (NVIDIA build or OpenRouter), from slash commands.

nvidia_api_key.title: NVIDIA API key
nvidia_api_key.description: Key from build.nvidia.com. Set this, the OpenRouter key, or both; choose which one to use first with /free-to-review:provider.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Key from openrouter.ai/keys. Set this, the NVIDIA key, or both; choose which one to use first with /free-to-review:provider.
